table.name: TLGNR_PLANT_WEWAS_BS
table.description: Mapping in order to store the wewas code of a certain plant. Plant_bs stores the plant_cd, and Logon uses this code everywhere, but in certain cases wewas code is used. (F. ex: SAP sending, wewas communication). Table used for NGE plants.

column.name: PLANT_WEWAS_CD
column.description: PK. Wewas code of the plant as supplied by wewas in 'supplyPlantAltNo'.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
